Population increased in Central Bedfordshire

The estimated population of Central Bedfordshire in 2024 was 315,877 usual residents, a rise of 2.1% since 2023.

This meant that Central Bedfordshire's rate of population change placed it among the 10 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Central Bedfordshire increased by 6.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Central Bedfordshire was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Central Bedfordshire

The average (median) age fell to 40.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Central Bedfordshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Central Bedfordshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Central Bedfordshire's population of 315,877 usual residents was made up of:

  • 62,754 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.9%)
  • 195,667 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.9%)
  • 57,456 people aged 65 years and over, (18.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Central Bedfordshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (19.9% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Central Bedfordshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Central Bedfordshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Central Bedfordshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,072 people (0.3%). In total, there were 3,532 births and 2,460 deaths in Central Bedfordshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 3,971 (1.3%). There were 20,204 people entering the area and 16,233 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Central Bedfordshire's population of 1,497 (0.5%) as a result of 2,673 people entering the area and 1,176 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Central Bedfordshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Central Bedfordshire in mid-2023 is 309,382.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 326 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 754 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,080 people.
